name: 宋版印坊

source.description: A contemporary archival presentation of a Song-era movable-type workshop: uncoated paper, ink-black rules, beech wood, cast iron and a single cinnabar accent.

fontFamilies.heading: Songti SC, STSong, Noto Serif CJK SC, serif

designStyle.visualLanguage: Editorial restraint modeled on a carefully catalogued hand-printing studio, using hard rules, generous paper margins and materially believable tools.

imagery.treatment: subtle grain, natural materials, no glow

designStyle.texture: Uncoated book paper fibers outside; beech grain, ink bloom and cast-iron wear inside the press canvas.
designStyle.density: compact controls with generous editorial margins
designStyle.personality: A working print room presented with the precision of a museum catalogue, never theatrical faux-antique styling.

effectsStrategy.rationale: The interaction itself is the visual effect; DOM styling stays editorial while Canvas renders the physical workshop.

visualMetaphor: A freshly catalogued proofing bench where an austere book page opens into a tactile working press.

responsive.strategy: The masthead collapses to one column, controls become full-width, and the fixed-ratio press scales without changing its mechanical coordinate system.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Disable transitions and reveal the printed sheet immediately.
